quick slots 评为 B 级
summary: soispoke 发布 MATCHA：frame 交易加上 keyed nonce 后，同一 sender 可能有多笔待处理交易，这会带来 DoS 风险；MATCHA 让 sender 只能凭已最终确认区块里实际用掉的 gas 赚取额外“宽度”。Gottfried Herold 建议 EIP-8250 用 nonce key 首字节区分一次性 nonce 和计数 nonce，以便将来用 Bloom 过滤器减少无状态节点存储。Trezor 开始支持 ERC-7730 清晰签名。

items.topic: 隐私应用的共享 sender 与内存池
items.title: soispoke：新文章 MATCHA
items.note: 20:52，ethresear.ch 正文。EIP-8141 通常每个 sender 只接纳一笔待处理交易；EIP-8250 让隐私应用的许多用户共用一个 sender 而 nonce 互不冲突，从而为接纳多笔交易打开可能。风险是：恶意应用可以提交大量有效花费，再用一次链上设置改动让整批失效，反复制造重验证负担；或者恶意用户用低费交易挤占诚实隐私应用的容量。MATCHA 作为本地内存池策略，让超出第一笔的每次接纳都花费分配给该 sender 的“宽度”，宽度只能由该 sender 在已最终确认区块中实际用掉的 gas 赚取，交易离开内存池也不返还。FOCIL 的 frame 交易扩展（EIP-8369）会让洪泛交易更容易被打包，从而让攻击更有成本。
items.note_en: 20:52, with the ethresear.ch post. EIP-8141 normally admits one pending transaction per sender; EIP-8250 lets many users of a privacy app share one sender without nonce conflicts, which opens the door to admitting several. The risks: a malicious app could submit many valid spends and then invalidate the whole set with one onchain settings change, repeating the revalidation burden; or a malicious user could crowd out an honest privacy app's capacity with low-fee transactions. MATCHA, a local mempool policy, makes every admission beyond the first spend "width" assigned to the sender, earned only from the gas that sender actually used in finalized blocks and not returned when a transaction leaves the mempool. The FOCIL extension for frame transactions (EIP-8369) would make flooding transactions more likely to be included, making the attack costlier.
items.topic_en: Shared senders and the mempool for privacy apps

summary_en: soispoke published MATCHA. With frame transactions and keyed nonces, one sender may have several pending transactions, which creates a DoS risk; MATCHA lets a sender earn extra "width" only from the gas it actually used in finalized blocks. Gottfried Herold suggested EIP-8250 use the first byte of the nonce key to tell one-shot nonces from counter nonces, so Bloom filters can later reduce storage for stateless nodes. Trezor began supporting ERC-7730 clear signing.
